_comment: Optional parts the installer offers on one page (Yggdrasil's installer shows title, intro and each entry's id, name, note; an entry starts chosen when its chosen_if_exists path is on the live system, i.e. this medium carries it). labyrinth-install-system: components = ids in /usr/share/labyrinth/components.json; ones on the medium are kept (or removed when not chosen), ones not on it are installed at the new user's first login (labyrinth-first-components, through Agora's password box; they need the internet).
title: AI and security
intro: Optional. Both can be added or removed later in Agora.

extras.name: Sarina
extras.note: Your local AI assistant: answers about this computer, fixes, voice. Runs only on this computer; works best with a graphics card with 8 GB or more. The first time you use her she fetches her model server and AI model (several GB).

extras.name: Heimdall
extras.note: Watches this computer for attacks, holds suspicious files and explains what it found. Works on its own; with Sarina it can also explain things in conversation.
